description: Count the open Raise Lens grants and tenders that match a search by topic, sector, country and deadline. Returns only the number and a link to the same search on raiselens.com; no records. New listings enter these results at once with full access; otherwise tenders and subcontracts 7 days and grants 30 days after Raise Lens lists them, or 7 days before they close if sooner.

deadline_before.description: Only opportunities closing on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

geography.description: Country or region: ISO-2 ("DE"), English name ("Germany"), or an aggregate ("EU", "Global South").

query.description: Search terms: what the project needs funding for.

sectors.description: Raise Lens sector slugs, such as renewable-energy. Only the first is used as a filter; put the rest in `query`.

name: count_matching_opportunities
title: Count matching funding opportunities
